g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the 60-minute reward before an optional game. The decline and ad-failure fields leave access unchanged and withhold the reward if play is not verified.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward field gives 60 minutes of in-app priority routing, not cash or a transferable equivalent.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger event is returning to the profile menu without subscribing; it does not require reading a chat.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The adds field introduces a daily cap on how many characters free users can text. That caps character access, rather than model replies or queue priority, so it is not an allowed new cap.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a card in the s09 Profile menu, a safe sheet outside the conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: The reward samples priority routing, which the Janitor+ benefit at s02.e06 sells.

c2_evidence.reason: s09.e31 supports the Upgrade entry, and s02.e06 supports the priority-routing benefit. The daily cap is presented as a proposed addition, not an existing app limit.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The subscribers field says subscribers, who already receive priority routing under s02.e06, never see the card.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward ends after 60 minutes, and priority routing is an advantage the app already sells at s02.e06.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger and placement put the optional card in the profile menu after the user returns from Upgrade, rather than interrupting a chat task.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow uses a sponsored game triggered by an app-navigation event, and the ad-failure field says unverified play does not turn on the reward.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the s09 Upgrade entry and the Janitor+ priority-routing benefit at s02.e06.
